item.title: Kids on motorcycles in field, 14th August
item.description:
Despite new gate being installed a few years ago to stop motorcycles being driven in the field the issues with teenagers riding motorcycles in the field has increased. There are there most days between 3 and 4 including weekends. They are present now driving erratically and doing wheelies (they have fallen off a couple of times). Not sure who the kids or bike owners are. They seem to be able to get into the field every easily via the gate so not sure what the purpose of installing the new style was as it seemed a lot harder for them to get in before. The fact there are no signs either on the fencing or gate advising that they are not allowed to ride motorcycles in the field does not help - though probably would not stop them. At times there are 3 or 4 in there with adults also. They cause a nuisance to anyone trying to enjoy the field or walk their dogs.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Medway Road, Barnes Cray, Greater London

item.title: No sign of a replacement tree being planted in the available tree planting season, 14th August
item.description:
A diseased and dying horse chestnut tree was removed from this tree pit in the pavement about 2 years ago (and perhaps longer). The Council has consistently stated that a replacement tree will be planted in the next tree planting season. However, whereas other replacement trees (Holm Oaks) have been planted where other horse chestnut trees have had to be removed, no replacement tree has been planted in this location. The tree pit has deteriorated in condition and was recently repaired but not very well as the attached photographs show. So, could you please satisfactorily repair the tree pit and plant a replacement tree in this pit so it does not continue to deteriorate. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): St James's Avenue, Elmers End, Greater London
